decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Doomsday combo to win the game. The combo involves casting Doomsday and then manipulating the top of your library to set up a win condition, usually using Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. The deck includes various cantrips to dig for combo pieces, as well as disruption in the form of counterspells. The goal is to efficiently find and execute the combo while defending it from opposing disruption to secure a victory.

This deck revolves around using Paradoxical Outcome to draw a large number of cards and generate massive amounts of mana using artifacts like Moxen and Mana Crypt. The deck also includes key artifacts like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel to combo off and win the game quickly. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade to protect the combo and control the opponent's spells. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with card draw and powerful artifact synergies.

This deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to create powerful combos and disrupt opponents. With a mix of card draw, tutors, countermagic, and targeted removal, it can quickly assemble its win condition and protect it from interference. The synergy between key cards like Bolas's Citadel, Brain Freeze, and Underworld Breach allows for explosive plays and can overwhelm opponents in a short amount of time. The deck aims to outmaneuver opponents by carefully managing resources and executing its game plan with precision.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong board presence. By utilizing disruptive creatures like Collector Ouphe and Leovold, Emissary of Trest, along with powerful planeswalkers like Oko, Thief of Crowns, the deck aims to control the game through tempo swings. The mana base is crafted to provide a solid foundation for the deck's spells, with additional disruption coming from cards like Force of Will and Assassin's Trophy. The deck's versatility and ability to adapt to different situations make it a strong contender in Vintage 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on playing disruptive creatures known as Hatebears to slow down the opponent while also maintaining aggression through efficient creatures like Luminarch Aspirant and Outland Liberator. The deck also utilizes powerful artifacts like Batterskull and Kaldra Compleat to further pressure the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence to close out the game quickly. Additionally, the deck includes mana acceleration cards like the Moxen and mana denial cards like Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively fill the graveyard with creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Vengevine, while also utilizing cards like Deathrite Shaman and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis. This allows for fast and consistent plays by bringing creatures back from the graveyard and overwhelming the opponent with powerful attackers. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Vigor and Once Upon a Time to maintain board control. Overall, the strategy focuses on leveraging the graveyard and aggressive creature plays to quickly win the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful control cards and disruptive spells to interfere with the opponent's game plan while setting up powerful win conditions such as Bolas's Citadel and Time Vault. It also includes various tutors to find key pieces and powerful mana accelerants like Black Lotus and Sol Ring to ramp into game-winning plays quickly. The deck's goal is to control the game's tempo, disrupt the opponent's plans, and then close out the game with its powerful win conditions and card advantage engines.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the powerful combo potential of Underworld Breach in Vintage 1 vs 1 format. The deck includes key cards like Black Lotus, Bolas's Citadel, and Urza's Saga to generate rich mana resources and enable explosive plays. By combining efficient card draw, disruption, and tutor effects, the deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to loop spells from the graveyard with Underworld Breach, ultimately overwhelming opponents with a flurry of powerful spells and winning the game.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive artifacts, supported by powerful mana acceleration and resource denial. The key strategy is to quickly deploy threats like Foundry Inspector and Walking Ballista while using cards like Sphere of Resistance and Thorn of Amethyst to slow down the opponent. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility by shutting off opponent's artifacts and fetching powerful artifacts from the sideboard. The deck aims to maintain board control and pressure the opponent to victory.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Bloodghast to enable powerful plays with cards like Vengevine and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis. By utilizing cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Once Upon a Time, the deck can consistently bring threats onto the battlefield early in the game. The inclusion of Force of Vigor helps deal with problematic artifacts and enchantments, while mana acceleration from cards like Black Lotus and Moxen allow for explosive plays. The deck's mana base also includes disruptive lands like Bazaar of Baghdad and Wasteland to disrupt opponents' strategies.

This deck focuses on playing efficient artifact creatures and lock pieces to disrupt the opponent's game plan while still being able to play powerful artifact spells like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge. The deck aims to use its mana acceleration from Mishra's Workshop and other artifact mana to ramp out its threats quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption. With cards like Sphere of Resistance and Thorn of Amethyst, the deck can slow down the opponent's spells while still being able to deploy threats of its own.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the resources needed to utilize the Underworld Breach combo. It includes a variety of fast mana acceleration, card draw, and disruption spells to efficiently cast and protect the combo pieces. The strategy revolves around using Underworld Breach to repeatedly recast powerful spells from the graveyard, generating massive card advantage and potentially overwhelming the opponent in a single turn. The deck aims to win the game through a high-speed and explosive combo sequence, leveraging its powerful spells and synergies to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.

This deck aims to quickly play powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Pyroblast. The deck also includes card draw and selection to ensure a consistent stream of threats and answers. By combining efficient creatures with disruption, the deck seeks to maintain pressure on the opponent and control the tempo of the game. The mana base is optimized for consistency and the inclusion of versatile cards like Dack Fayden and Brazen Borrower provide additional utility and flexibility.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the powerful interaction between Underworld Breach and various spells such as Brain Freeze, Ancestral Recall, and Demonic Tutor. By combining card draw, tutoring, and recursion, the deck aims to assemble a lethal combo that can either mill the opponent's entire library or generate infinite mana with cards like Lotus Petal and Bolas's Citadel. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Pyroblast to protect the combo and ensure a successful win condition.

The deck focuses on using artifact creatures and mana acceleration to quickly build a board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining powerful artifact creatures like Bronze Guardian and Nettlecyst with mana producing artifacts like Mox Opal and Mishra's Workshop, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast aggressive strategy. Additionally, cards like Sphere of Resistance and Phyrexian Revoker are included to disrupt the opponent's spells and abilities, further solidifying the deck's aggressive playstyle. The deck's main goal is to control the board early on and quickly close out the game with powerful artifact creatures.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Noble Hierarch to apply pressure quickly. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for extra value from the graveyard. The deck also has access to powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to gain card advantage and take extra turns. Overall, the deck aims to control the game while beating down the opponent with efficient creatures.
